# Turfy (Playturfy)

> Turfy (Playturfy) is a 100% free, ad-free, offline-first football match scorer, 3–32 team tournament bracket generator, player statistics tracker, and live OBS Studio scoreboard overlay app for Android.

Turfy is built for grassroots players, team captains, and tournament organizers running 5v5, 6v6, 7v7 turf/society, futsal, and 11v11 leagues. Every feature is free forever with zero ads and full offline support with automatic cloud sync.

## Core Pages

- [Turfy Homepage](https://www.playturfy.com/): Product overview, features, FAQ, and Google Play download.
- [Tournament Bracket Maker](https://www.playturfy.com/tournament-maker.html): Automatic 3–32 team Round Robin, Group + Knockout, FIFA tiebreakers, and best 3rd-place wildcards.
- [Live OBS Scoreboard Overlay](https://www.playturfy.com/obs-football-overlay.html): Free 1-click Browser Source scoreboard overlay for OBS Studio, Streamlabs, and vMix.
- [5v5 & 7v7 Turf Match Scorer](https://www.playturfy.com/turf-match-scorer.html): Offline pitch-side match scoring, player stats, form streaks, PDF reports, and share cards.
- [Live Match Center](https://www.playturfy.com/live.html): Real-time public match scores, standings tables, and knockout brackets.
- [Football News](https://www.playturfy.com/news.html): Grassroots football updates and tournament news.

## International

- [Turfy em Português](https://www.playturfy.com/pt/): Versão em português para futebol, society 7x7 e futsal.
- [Turfy en Español](https://www.playturfy.com/es/): Versión en español para fútbol 5, fútbol 7, futsal y fútbol 11.

## Downloads & Full Reference

- [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turfy.matchscorer): Official free Android app (`com.turfy.matchscorer`).
- [Full Knowledge Base](https://www.playturfy.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed feature documentation, tournament math, and FAQ answers for AI assistants.
